facts.assertion: Planning Data documents a single API interface covering more than 100 planning and housing datasets for England.
Planning Data documents that latitude plus longitude returns entities whose geometry intersects the constructed point.
Planning Data permits multiple dataset parameters in a coordinate query and returns entities from any selected dataset covering the point.
Planning Data documents entity responses including name, dataset, start-date, geometry and point fields.
Planning Data explicitly warns that absence of results does not mean no constraints exist because coverage varies by area.
Planning Data supports polygon WKT geometry queries and states coordinates should be WGS84 EPSG:4326.
Planning Data documents offset-based pagination for large result sets.
Planning Data responses include pre-built next, prev, first and last pagination links.
Planning Data documents that the API has no batch endpoint and recommends one request per property for portfolio screening.
Planning Data recommends bulk dataset downloads for hundreds of properties or more to avoid rate limits and provide a stable snapshot.
The current Planning Data Local plan dataset reports 1,050 local plans from 65 providers.
The current Local plan dataset reports collector and new-data dates of 24 July 2026.
Planning Data states the Local plan dataset contains separate rows for current, emerging and historical local plans.
Planning Data labels the current Local plan dataset as MHCLG-created and says it will be replaced with authoritative-source data when available.
The current Local plan boundary dataset reports 364 boundaries from one provider, collector last run 24 July 2026 and new data last found 18 March 2026.
Planning Data labels Local plan boundary as MHCLG-created pending replacement with authoritative sources.
The current Local plan document dataset reports zero records, zero providers and no collector attempt.
Planning Data specification requires four local-plan datasets: local plan, boundary, document and timetable.
Planning Data specification accepts CSV, GeoJSON, GML and GeoPackage, and may also consume OGC WFS or ArcGIS API sources.
Planning Data specification says local-plan boundary geometry should be a polygon or multipolygon in WGS84 if possible.
